title: A Large Scale Benchmark for Test Time Adaptation Methods in Medical Image Segmentation (MedSeg-TTA)
mechanism: Benchmarks 20 TTA methods across 7 modalities under one backbone, one preprocessing and one protocol, in four families: input, feature, output and prior.
adaptation: Template for the benchmark's TTA track: fixed backbone, a no-TTA primary number, region plus boundary metrics, and explicit reporting of degradations. Reuse its implementations to port Tent, SAR, CoTTA and VPTTA to U-Net++.
min_experiment: Not a training run. Copy the table layout and metric pair into the benchmark protocol, and reuse its implementations for rows 10, 12, 14 and 15.
evidence: R: no paradigm wins everywhere. Input-level methods are most stable under mild shift; feature- and output-level methods help boundary metrics; several methods degrade under large inter-center shifts.
